_doc: One entry per file vendored from ECC or substantially derived from it. upstream_commit + upstream_path pin the merge base for the maintainer's ecc mode; modifications record local intent so a later sync can tell it from upstream change. Each local_path carries the notice comments in its frontmatter, ending in '@ <first 7 characters of upstream_commit>'. upstream_body_sha256 is the sha256 of the upstream file's body (everything after its frontmatter); the local body minus its '## Inputs from feature-workflow' section must hash to it. The plugin repository's CLAUDE.md, 'Vendored ECC agents', holds the rules.
